what_happened.line: The School Committee voted 3-0 by roll call to approve a line-item transfer, one of several annual adjustments within the approved budget.
The committee voted 3-0 to appoint its chair as the committee's representative for secretaries' contract negotiations.
It voted 3-0 to declare four vision testing machines surplus and 3-0 to accept two donations to the Turkey Hill gift account.
Committee goals were tabled, and the town bylaw review vote was tabled until the school revolving account is clarified.
The committee heard a transportation survey update covering busing students within a mile and a half, including the cost of an additional bus and fees in other districts.

why_it_matters: Transportation fees and the cost of an added bus could become a budget decision, and families whose children live within a mile and a half of school would be the ones affected.

The year-end transfers and a possible health insurance surplus show where the approved school budget moved after adoption, which matters for what the town's tax-funded appropriation actually paid for.
watch_next: Extended day fee changes are due back for a vote at the next School Committee meeting.
Draft committee goals on equity, workshops and community awareness are due at the next meeting, along with the tabled bylaw review once the revolving account is clarified.
